answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short. A nebula of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lagoon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
